Main Finding: Adverse risk rises strongly with age.
Poorer functional status is associated with substantially higher adverse risk.
Dialysis is associated with higher adjusted adverse hazard.
Male and female classification recall was similar, although small risk differences remained.
Interpretation: Differences should not automatically be interpreted as model bias.

Main Finding: Blood type groups differ in transplant and adverse-event patterns.
Interpretation: Likely influenced by compatibility and allocation processes.

Main Finding: Performance and adverse-risk differences were observed across ETHCAT groups.
Interpretation: Requires careful fairness analysis; numeric ETHCAT codes should not be renamed without the official mapping.

Main Finding: Regional differences were present in both model behavior and outcome patterns.
Interpretation: May reflect geography, access, center practices, or other factors.
